texts.zh:
[from.GetName]是一种非凡的地衣物种的家园，它们将剧毒分子排入大气中，以保护自己免受捕食者的侵害。

化石记录的研究得知[from.GetName]曾经有丰富多样的物种，但这种地衣以超出生物所能适应的速度梯度提高了大气中的砷和铊浓度，这些物种都被被逐一灭绝了。

[Leader.GetName]只发现了另一种存活的有机体，是一种大型类爬行动物，它们要靠特别高效的解毒腺体在这种环境中存活下来。

对这种非凡器官的进一步研究可能会对大气解毒产生洞见。
texts.en:
[from.GetName] is home to a remarkable species of lichen which expels ultra-toxic molecules into the atmosphere as a method to secure itself against predation.

Studies of the fossil record suggest [from.GetName] once had a diverse range of fauna which the lichen has killed off over time by gradually raising levels of arsenic and thallium in the atmosphere faster than most could adapt.

[Leader.GetName] discovered only one other living organism, a species of large reptiloids, has been able to survive to such conditions thanks to a uniquely efficient detoxification gland.

Further study of this remarkable organ could yield insights into atmospheric detoxification.

texts.en:
[from.GetName] is home to a remarkable species of lichen which expels ultra-toxic molecules into the atmosphere as a method to secure itself against predation.

Studies of the fossil record suggest [from.GetName] once had a diverse range of fauna which the lichen has killed off over time by gradually raising levels of arsenic and thallium in the atmosphere faster than most could adapt.

[Leader.GetName] discovered only one other living organism, a species of large reptiloids, has been able to survive to such conditions thanks to a uniquely efficient detoxification gland.

Further study of this remarkable organ could yield insights into atmospheric detoxification. Initial experiments also indicate that the unique compounds inside the poisons could be repurposed for use in the cosmetic industry.

这种复杂的器官会分泌一种可以对毒性大气起到中和作用的化合物，避免这种类爬行动物的循环系统吸收毒素。这种极具适应力的腺体甚至可以中和掉我们实验室制造的最致命的毒素。

这些非凡的发现将彻底改变我们大气排毒的方式。
texts.en:
Through intensive study of the reptiloid glands on [from.GetName], [Leader.GetName] has uncovered the biological secrets of their remarkable resistance to the planet's toxicity.

This complex organ produces compounds which act as neutralizing agents to the poisonous atmosphere, preventing toxins from being absorbed by the reptile's circulatory system. This highly adaptive gland is even able to nullify our most lethal lab-generated poisons.

These extraordinary findings will transform our approaches to atmospheric detoxification.

summary.text:
# 毒性大气 / Poisoned Atmosphere

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc）

## 如何开始 How it starts

有毒星球可能生成（3级，权重3；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a toxic planet (level 3, weight 3; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.140“毒性大气”：选项a获得每月社会研究并启用项目 DETOXIFICATION_GLAND_PROJECT“解毒腺体研究”（180天）；选项b（仅非集体意识）获得每月贸易加成与 d_trade_value_3 矿藏。项目完成后 extreme_frontiers.145“排毒洞见”：推进下一个殖民科技（tech_colonization_2…5，各25%），全部完成则获得每月社会研究。

Single result extreme_frontiers.140 "Poisoned Atmosphere": option a gives monthly society research and enables project DETOXIFICATION_GLAND_PROJECT (180 days); option b (non-gestalt only) gives monthly trade and a d_trade_value_3 deposit. Completion fires extreme_frontiers.145 "Detoxification Insight": 25% progress on the next colonization tech (tech_colonization_2 to 5), else monthly society research.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

140 的选项a/b二选一；只有选项a通向项目与 145。

140's options a/b are alternatives; only a leads to the project and 145.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

140 的描述与选项b按是否集体意识变化。

140's description and option b depend on gestalt status.
